source_anchors.quote: We searched PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane Library for randomized controlled trials comparing early aortic valve replacement with conservative management in asymptomatic patients with severe aortic stenosis until December 2024. The primary efficacy outcome was a composite of all‐cause mortality, hospitalization for cardiovascular causes, stroke, and myocardial infarction. We expressed outcome data as risk ratios (RRs) with 95% CIs.
